prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished desktop website design comp, 1536x1024 landscape: the homepage first viewport plus the beginning of the next section. A real web layout, edge to edge, no device frame and no browser chrome. Brand: Birdcar, the consulting practice of Nick Cannariato, one Silicon Valley systems engineer who builds purpose-built tools and workflows for established service businesses, so their teams do better work faster and grow without another hire. Visual world: a Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen, where a visible construction grid is the armature of the whole page and the poster is the proof.

STRUCTURE, in reading order:
1. A faint construction grid of hairlines (#e3e8ec) in square 32px cells covers the whole white (#ffffff) page. The navigation row locks to the grid, 80px tall: at left the wordmark "Birdcar" in a forward-leaning mid-century connected brush script (Alkaline style) in ink #101418, the only curved letterforms on the page. At right: small neutral grotesk links "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing", and an outlined ink rectangle button "Book a free Walkthrough".
2. First viewport. LEFT two-thirds (x 60 to 1000): a monumental headline built cell by cell from the grid in a square-cornered geometric grid-constructed display face, ink, three lines filling the space: "BETTER" / "WORK," / "FASTER." Toward the right edge of the last word, some of its cells are still scattered and drifting loose, a few squares floating off-grid, as if the letters are assembling from chaos into order. A single bold canary-yellow (#f5c400) diagonal line, the only diagonal on the page, cuts upward from the lower right of the headline, with a tiny geometric canary glyph at its tip.
RIGHT third (x 1040 to 1480): a small neutral grotesk subline at about 20px: "I build the tools and workflows that let your team do better work, faster, so you can grow without hiring another coordinator." Primary action: a solid ink block spanning grid cells with white text "Book a free Walkthrough ⁄". Beneath: small text "One pitch-free hour. A written report within three business days. Yours to keep."
3. Lower band (y 800 to 1024): a row of four outlined grid cells forming a specimen catalog, each with a number and label in a neutral grotesk and a small plus mark: "01 Connect your tools", "02 Internal tools", "03 Client portals", "04 Reporting & follow-up". Beside or beneath them: a small line "Where I've built systems" and monochrome typographic wordmarks GitHub, Heroku, Zapier, Twilio, Salesforce.

ART DIRECTION: One dominant move: the monumental gridded headline assembling itself, with the single yellow diagonal. Everything else calm and exact. No purple, no gradients, no AI imagery, no stock photos, no fake metrics or testimonials. Preserve all quoted words exactly. Treat it as a finished, shippable website.
